_comment: What each corpus bucket is expected to achieve, per oracle. Data, not code,
because the expectations FLIP as the port grows and a gate that fails on
every run says nothing on the run where something actually breaks.
These are FLOORS and the suite is a ratchet. Dropping below one is a
regression and fails. Rising above one also fails, so that the improvement
is recorded here deliberately, in a commit whose diff says what got better.
